placeholderImages.name: Aviatur - E-commerce Web Site
placeholderImages.description: Comprehensive travel and booking platform for one of the largest travel agencies in the region.
placeholderImages.goal: Modernize the online booking experience and integrate multiple travel services into a single platform.
placeholderImages.overview: Aviatur required a complete digital transformation to stay competitive in a rapidly evolving travel market. The project involved re-engineering the booking engine for flights, hotels, and packages.
placeholderImages.problem: The legacy platform was fragmented, had high cart abandonment rates, and lacked a mobile-first approach, frustrating users during complex booking processes.
placeholderImages.objective: To create a unified, high-performance booking ecosystem that simplifies the travel planning process and increases conversion rates by 25%.
placeholderImages.strategy: We implemented a modular design system and a streamlined 'one-click' checkout flow. We also integrated real-time data APIs to provide instant pricing and availability.
placeholderImages.impact: Launched a seamless multi-device platform that resulted in a 30% increase in mobile bookings and significantly improved user satisfaction scores.
placeholderImages.decisions: Implemented a modular 'Step-by-Step' booking flow to reduce cognitive load, resulting in a 15% decrease in drop-off rates during the critical payment stage.

placeholderImages.name: Orbit Group Partners - Dashboard
placeholderImages.description: A comprehensive coaching platform designed to help users achieve their goals by tracking real-time performance metrics.
placeholderImages.goal: To overhaul the user experience by implementing WCAG accessibility standards and creating a robust Design System.
placeholderImages.role: Lead UI/UX Designer, Design System Architecture
placeholderImages.overview: Orbit is a B2B SaaS platform that needed to scale its analytics capabilities while maintaining a user-friendly interface for non-technical managers.
placeholderImages.problem: Data overload was preventing users from identifying actionable insights. The interface was also inconsistent across different modules.
placeholderImages.objective: Design a centralized dashboard that prioritizes key performance indicators (KPIs) and ensures 100% WCAG AA compliance.
placeholderImages.strategy: Developed a custom icon library and a color-coded data visualization strategy using D3.js. We prioritized 'Progressive Disclosure' to hide complex data until needed.
placeholderImages.impact: Reduced user training time by 40% and improved task completion rates within the platform by 50%.
placeholderImages.decisions: Adopted a 'Mobile-First' approach for the critical dashboard alerts, ensuring that performance drops are notified and readable on any device instantly.
